metas.name: The Season
metas.description: A group of friends in Hong Kong's elite boating scene find their summer getaway descending into betrayal and power plays as hidden agendas surface.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

metas.name: The Testaments
metas.description: Growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known. As a new generation of young women grapple with the bleak future that awaits them, they will be forced to search for allies, new and old, to help in their fight for freedom.

metas.name: The Trap
metas.description: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

metas.name: The Westies
metas.description: As the Javits Center construction project ignites a battle for profit in early 1980s Hell's Kitchen, a generational rift threatens the uneasy peace between violent Irish gang the Westies and the Mafia, and draws FBI heat.

metas.name: the Wonderfools
metas.description: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

metas.name: Treasure Island
metas.description: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

metas.name: Tyson
metas.description: This gripping four-part documentary series explores the explosive life of Mike Tyson — one of the most feared and fascinating figures in sports history.

metas.name: Unconditional
metas.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

metas.name: Unfamiliar
metas.description: When the past catches up with two former spies, their biggest challenge isn't car chases, shootouts or fistfights — it's telling each other the truth.

metas.name: Vanished
metas.description: When a romantic getaway to Paris takes a dark turn with the sudden disappearance of her boyfriend Tom aboard a train to the south of France, Alice is plunged into a web of intrigue and danger, uncovering shocking secrets about the man she thought she knew.

metas.name: Vimal Khanna
metas.description: An accountant accused of killing his brother flees, assumes the identity Vimal Khanna, and faces blackmail while seeking his vanished wife. Survival and accidental heroism drive noir-style rescues and moral choices.

metas.name: Viral Hit (Kenka Dokugaku)
metas.description: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.

metas.name: Virginpur
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

metas.name: Vladimir
metas.description: When an English professor becomes obsessed with a handsome new colleague, her already complicated marriage and career are thrown into total chaos.

metas.name: Waiting Hai
metas.description: Sugam joins the RPF and investigates a Tatkal scam. Hamza and Mama turn booking software into a business, facing rivalry and betrayal. Sugam arrests the agents and tracks Hamza, ending the scam before his escape to Dubai.

metas.name: We Are All Trying Here
metas.description: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

metas.name: Wonder Man
metas.description: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

metas.name: Young Sherlock
metas.description: Sherlock Holmes is a disgraced young man, raw and unfiltered, when he finds himself wrapped up in a murder case that threatens his liberty. His first ever case unravels a globe-trotting conspiracy that changes his life forever.

metas.name: 13th Some Lessons Arent Taught In Classrooms
metas.description: 13th tells the story of Ritesh, a successful venture capitalist who reunites with his maverick IIT-JEE mentor, Mohit Tyagi Sir, to help scale his visionary educational institute. The series unfolds against the backdrop of India's most gruelling academic competition and a startup culture fixated on valuations. At its heart, 13th is a deeply nostalgic, human story of a master and his pupil-bound by ambition, respect, and the lessons that shape a lifetime.

metas.name: A Taste for Murder
metas.description: Folder: English

metas.name: Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, the psychological expert and the detective in charge are all left asking: what really happened?

metas.name: Aema
metas.description: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

metas.name: Agra Affair
metas.description: Akash struggles to save his family's crumbling hotel while pursuing his dream restaurant. He falls for tour guide Tanvi, but their romance faces hurdles. Akash's path intertwines with Megha's, leading to a poignant story of love, ambition.

metas.name: Alien Earth
metas.description: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: All Her Fault
metas.description: In Chicago, Marissa Irvine arrives at 14 Arthur Avenue, expecting to pick up her young son Milo from his first playdate with a boy at his new school. But the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes. She isn't the nanny. She doesn't have Milo. And so begins every parent's worst nightmare.

metas.name: American Manhunt O J Simpson
metas.description: The white Bronco. The gloves. The trial of the century. This documentary series investigates the shocking murder case that became a cultural phenomenon.

metas.name: American Primeval
metas.description: A mother and son fleeing from their past form a found family while confronting a harsh landscape of freedom and cruelty in the American West.

metas.name: Andhera
metas.description: In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

metas.name: Apple Cider Vinegar
metas.description: Two young women advocate for wellness remedies to cure deadly illnesses, unraveling their lives as they unknowingly — and knowingly — mislead the world.

metas.name: Arabia Kadali
metas.description: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

metas.name: As You Stood By
metas.description: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

metas.name: Bad Thoughts
metas.description: A collection of hilariously disturbing stories that push the boundaries of decency in ways only Tom Segura could imagine.

metas.name: Badaa Naam Karenge
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Bakaiti 2025
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Ballard
metas.description: Detective Renée Ballard plunges into a web of murder and corruption as she hunts a ruthless serial killer and uncovers a sinister police conspiracy that threatens everything she stands for. With her own demons nipping at her heels, Ballard must outwit both criminals and colleagues to bring long-overdue justice to the victims and their families.

metas.name: Bat Fam
metas.description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

metas.name: Batashey Gungun
metas.description: Love, obsession, and deception collide when Pallabi’s desire for Arindam, her married professor, spirals out of control. As her obsession deepens, Arindam fights to save his marriage to Mithila. But when emotions turn explosive, no one escapes the storm unharmed.

metas.name: Bergerac
metas.description: Ex-cop Jim Bergerac is forced to confront a troubling past case when a wealthy woman is murdered, pushing him to overcome personal demons and reignite his investigative prowess to navigate family tensions and law enforcement scrutiny.

metas.name: Bet
metas.description: At a private school where gambling determines social status, a skillful new student with a mysterious past is shaking things up — and betting on revenge.

metas.name: Beyond the Bar
metas.description: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

metas.name: Bhay The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
metas.description: Gaurav Tiwari, a paranormal investigator, faces his greatest challenge when his pursuit of the truth behind unexplained phenomena leads him into a deadly spiral. As his mysterious death leaves questions unanswered, a journalist delves into his eerie and celebrated legacy, unearthing secrets that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.

metas.name: Bibhishon
metas.description: Daily life at Bolagarh police station in Birbhum district is slow paced, uneventful. Until one day, a missing person and a theft case are reported. Mysteries unfold and murders come to the surface.

metas.name: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
metas.description: With humour, absurdity and family cat and mouse at its center, this is a tale of family gangsters in a fictitious madhouse city, Bindiya. As the current Don is put behind bars, the gangster family's alliances shift, new love, friendships, and betrayals explode until Bindiya becomes a full-blown circus-where love is a deal, power is personal, and every one has a card and blood on their hands.

metas.name: Black Rabbit
metas.description: A rising-star restaurateur is forced into New York's criminal underworld when his chaotic brother returns to town with loan sharks on his trail.

metas.name: Black Warrant
metas.description: When an upright officer accepts a job at Tihar Jail, he vows to make amends after witnessing cold-blooded corruption within its walls.

metas.name: Black White & Gray Love Kills
metas.description: Truth is never black or white. A high-profile case of serial killings takes an unexpected turn when forbidden love and deception come into play. In a world where love can kill, uncovering the truth is more dangerous than ever.

metas.name: Boots
metas.description: After impulsively joining the U.S. Marine Corps, a bullied teen finds new purpose — and unexpected brotherhood — with his motley team of fellow recruits.

metas.name: Butterfly
metas.description: David Jung, a mysterious former US intelligence operative living in hiding in South Korea, has his life blown to pieces when the consequences of an impossible decision from his past come back to haunt him, and he finds himself hunted by Rebecca, a deadly young assassin, and Caddis, the sinister spy organization she works for.

metas.name: Cassandra
metas.description: A family moves into a vintage smart home and discovers that it's under the control of a virtual assistant — who will stop at nothing to keep them there.

metas.name: Celebrity Bear Hunt
metas.description: Holly Willoughby hosts this competition show set in the Costa Rican jungle, where 12 celebrities become prey for legendary survival expert, Bear Grylls.

metas.name: Chad Powers
metas.description: Eight years after an unforgivable mistake nukes his promising college football career, hotshot quarterback Russ Holliday tries to resurrect his dreams by disguising himself as Chad Powers - a talented oddball who walks on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish.

metas.name: Chhal Kapat The Deception
metas.description: When a famous influencer is found dead during a destination wedding in a remote village, a cynical yet brilliant cop unearths dark secrets, hidden betrayals, and shocking truths, as every guest becomes a suspect in a twisted web of love.

metas.name: Chidiya Udd
metas.description: Inspired by real incidents and based on a book Cages by Abid Surti - Chidiya Udd is a story of struggle and fighting all odds told from the eyes of the protagonist, a 20-year-old Seher, who hails from Rajasthan. We follow her journey to Mumbai with a dream of making it in the big city. Set against the backdrop of gang wars and a dark underbelly of crime, will Seher survive Bombay?

metas.name: Chief of War
metas.description: With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, the ferocious warrior Kaʻiana embarks on an epic mission to unite his people—as an existential threat approaches their shores.

metas.name: CO ED
metas.description: Twins Shikha and Nikhil couldn't be more different. But when their all-boys and all-girls schools suddenly go co-ed, the chaos of teenagehood hits them head-on. Now, both must confront new feelings, friendships, and the messy business of growing up together.

metas.name: Code of Silenc
metas.description: A deaf catering worker who is struggling to make ends meet is called upon by a police detective superintendent to lip-read the conversations of criminals.

metas.name: Confidence Queen
metas.description: Three con artists with different backgrounds, team up for a daring and adventurous scheme of revenge against the villains of this era.

metas.name: Countdown
metas.description: When an officer with the Department of Homeland Security is murdered in broad daylight, LAPD detective Mark Meachum is recruited to a secret task force, alongside undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement, to investigate. But the hunt for the killer soon uncovers a plot far more sinister than anyone could have imagined, kicking off a race against time to save a city of millions.

metas.name: Court of Gold
metas.description: Go behind the scenes with the top medal contenders in men's basketball as they battle for gold and glory at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

metas.name: Crime Beat
metas.description: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

metas.name: Crime Patrol 26 Jurm 26 Cases
metas.description: From disturbing murder cases to gripping investigations, follow police officers as they delve into the most violent crimes that plague society.

metas.name: Criminal Justice A Family Matter
metas.description: Attorney Madhav Mishra represents Raj Nagpal, discovered with murdered nurse Roshni Saluja after his child's party. As the trial unfolds, hidden facts emerge, questioning identities.

metas.name: Dabba Cartel
metas.description: When an investigation into a pharma company hits close to home, five women launch a tiffin service with a secret ingredient.

metas.name: Daredevil Born Again
metas.description: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

metas.name: Death by Lightning
metas.description: The story of James Garfield, who rose from obscurity to become America's 20th President — and Charles Guiteau, the man who assassinated him.

metas.name: Dept Q
metas.description: A brash but brilliant cop becomes head of a new police department, where he leads an unlikely team of misfits in solving Edinburgh's cold cases.

metas.name: Detective Charulata
metas.description: Folder: Indian_Bangla

metas.name: Devika And Danny
metas.description: Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

metas.name: Devil May Cry
metas.description: In this epic battle of good vs. evil, the lines are blurry as hell. But a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

metas.name: Dexter Resurrection
metas.description: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

metas.name: Do You Wanna Partner
metas.description: Best friends Shikha and Anahita turn entrepreneurs with an exciting craft beer brand, Jugaaro, to stand out in the crowded NCR beer market. However, they face gender discrimination every step of the way. To fight for an equal place in this male dominated sector, they decide to invent a fictitious male partner to help smooth their way. Invariably, things don’t go exactly as planned. What follows are their collective adventures & misadventures in trying to build a successful start-up amidst the current boom, as the bunch of misfits band together and become a family.

metas.name: Doc
metas.description: Dr. Amy Larsen must navigate an unfamiliar world after a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

metas.name: Dupahiya 2025
metas.description: Folder: Hindi

metas.name: Ek Farzi Love Story
metas.description: Two contrasting worlds collide when an aspiring content creator Kritika and social media-averse CA, Manav find themselves stuck together thanks to an unexpected encounter. A viral video of their unique banter becomes the foundation of an unconventional partnership, where they have nothing in common, common except the fact that they agree to disagree on everything. As they become unlikely best friends offline, they pretend to be a fake couple online for the sake of their followers, who perceive them as a couple and as their fandom explodes they become an internet sensation.

metas.name: Eyes of Wakanda
metas.description: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

metas.name: Film Club
metas.description: Friday night. 7pm. Film Club Week 198. Evie hasn't left the house in six months after a 'wobble', and Film Club is her escape. A weekly chance to create a world of wonder, deck the garage out in whatever the movie calls for and spend a few uninterrupted hours with Noa - her best friend and one of the few mates who still shows up. But tonight, things are different. Noa's got big news. A dream job is taking him across the other side of the country, which means that all of this is ending.

metas.name: First Copy
metas.description: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

metas.name: Ganoshotru
metas.description: A crime series that chronicles the lives and reigns of five of West Bengal's most feared public enemies - villains, whose terror once gripped different corners of the state.

metas.name: Genie Make a Wish
metas.description: After a thousand years, a quirky genie returns to grant wishes to a woman born without feelings. Can his magic bring love and wonder to her world?

metas.name: Good Boy
metas.description: Olympic medalists join the police force through a special recruitment program, trading medals for badges as they tackle violent crimes and injustices with their athletic skills.

metas.name: Gram Chikitsalay
metas.description: The young, idealistic and brilliant Dr. Prabhat, takes charge of a neglected Primary Health Centre in a North India Village hoping to bring about much needed changes only to realise it is he who will have do change before anything else.

metas.name: Griha Laxmi
metas.description: Laxmi, a housewife in Betalgadh, stumbles upon weed during a police chase and starts selling it to save her family, navigating danger, secrets, and morality to become Betalgadh's queen of weed.

metas.name: Had I Not Seen the Sun
metas.description: Filmmaker Zhou Pin-yu interviews a serial killer in prison — an encounter that triggers a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.

metas.name: Hai Junoon
metas.description: Talent vs Ambition. Music vs Dance. At Anderson College, rivalries explode in a cut-throat battle for the GOATs Trophy. Who will rise? Who will break?

metas.name: Happiness Thailand
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: Heart and Hustle Houston
metas.description: A sisterhood of successful Black women is redefining what it means to be a mother, wife and boss in Houston, Texas -- all while supporting each other.

metas.name: Heweliusz
metas.description: After a catastrophic ferry disaster, the off-duty captain seeks answers and justice for those who lost their lives — and those they left behind.

metas.name: Hostage
metas.description: When the British prime minister's husband is kidnapped and the French president starts receiving threats, both leaders must face an impossible choice.

metas.name: House of David
metas.description: Tells the story of the ascent of the biblical figure, David, who becomes the most celebrated king of Israel. The series follows the once-mighty King Saul as he falls victim to his own pride. At the direction of God, the prophet Samuel anoints an unlikely, outcast teenager as the new king.

metas.name: House of Guinness
metas.description: Dublin, 1868. The Guinness family patriarch is dead, and his four children — each with dark secrets to hide — hold the brewery's fate in their hands.

metas.name: Human
metas.description: Paleoanthropologist Ella Al-Shamahi reveals humanity's incredible story across 300,000 years of human evolution – and how the story is stranger and more surprising than ever imagined.

metas.name: Ironheart
metas.description: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

metas.name: IT Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, amid a spate of unexplained disappearances of local children, a group of misfit friends begin to suspect a long-buried ancient evil lurking. As the kids set out to determine what's really going on, a rising unease prompts several townspeople to work together to restore peace – all while a U.S. military operation seeks to exploit Derry for its own objectives.

metas.name: Iyanu
metas.description: Set in the magical kingdom of Yorubaland, follow teenage orphan girl, Iyanu, a heroine who must uncover the mystery behind her newfound powers to save her people from an ancient curse threatening to destroy humanity.

metas.name: Janaawar The Beast Within
metas.description: As SI Hemant Kumar explores a missing person's case in the jungle town of Chhattisgarh, he is determined to solve it. Trouble follows when that leads to a string of bodies and a likely serial killer.

metas.name: Kaiju No 8
metas.description: Folder: Animes

metas.name: Kanneda
metas.description: Against the backdrop of 1990s Toronto, a Punjabi singer's journey from street performer to rising star leads him into dangerous territory.

metas.name: Khakee The Bengal Chapter
metas.description: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata's feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.
